description: Compare two menu files (from snapshot_menu save_as, or toolmenu snapshot): breaking changes for clients, the token change per conversation, and the version bump it needs. Reads files only.

before.description: The older menu file, e.g. the committed menu.json.

cwd.description: Folder to run from: where the server starts, toolmenu.config.json is read and relative paths resolve. Default: where toolmenu mcp runs.

release.description: The release versions to check the bump against: "1.4.0..1.5.0".

name: diff_menus
